name: Barbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet hip width, bar over the middle of your feet.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs.
Flatten your back, lift your chest and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up tall, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Push your hips back and lower the bar under control to the floor.
cues: Squeeze glutes at the top, don't lean back
Big breath and brace before each lift

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the lower back off the floor
common_mistakes.fix: Lighten the load, brace hard and lift the chest before pulling

common_mistakes.mistake: Bar drifting away from the body
common_mistakes.fix: Pull the bar into your shins and thighs the whole way

common_mistakes.mistake: Jerking the bar up from the floor
common_mistakes.fix: Pull the slack out first, then press the floor away smoothly
